question: How much higher the average intrinsic value is for trades using the feeling-lucky strategy compared to those using the momentum strategy under long-side trades?
sql:
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' THEN ABS(StrikePrice - LastPx) END) as feeling_lucky_avg,
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%' THEN ABS(StrikePrice - LastPx) END) as momentum_avg,
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' THEN ABS(StrikePrice - LastPx) END) - 
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%' THEN ABS(StrikePrice - LastPx) END) as difference
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report`, UNNEST(Sides) s
WHERE (TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' OR TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%')
  AND s.Side = 'LONG'
